newsitem.title: USA: Edmark CEO resigns for health reasons.
newsitem.headline: Edmark CEO resigns for health reasons.

text.p: Edmark Corp said chairman and chief executive Sally Narodick is resigning due to stress-related health problems.
The company said Donna Stanger, vice president, product development, will assume the duties of chief executive on an interim basis and the board has formed a committee to search for a permanent CEO.
Edmark said Frances Conley, a director of the company since 1991 will serve as chairman of the board.

"This has been a very difficult decision for me, but one that I feel is in the best interests of the company," said Narodick in a press release. "I have been experiencing some stress-related health problems that are interfering with my ability to continue as Edmark's CEO. I have worked very closely with Donna and have great confidence in her ability to assume these new responsibilities," Norodick said.
Edmark Corp is a developer and publisher of educational software and materials.
